question: The second Round Table Conference was held in 1931 in which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**UK**__.

__
 
• **The Second Round Table Conference was held in 1931 in the UK.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Second Round Table Conference:**

 
 
• The Second Round Table Conference took place in** 1931 AD.**
 
• The Second Round Table Conference was presided by **Ramsay Macdonald, Prime Minister of Britain. **
 
• The British Government refused to concede the basic nationalist demand for freedom on the basis of the immediate grant of dominion status with complete control over the defence, external affairs and finance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** attended the **Second Round Table Conference only.**
 
• **Tej Bahadur Sapru and Dr B.R. Ambedkar** attended all three round table conferences.
